title: Join products with categories and suppliers to create produc
question: Join products with categories and suppliers to create productinfo with ProductID, ProductName, Unit, Price and all category/supplier attributes.
sql:
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS productinfo;
CREATE VIEW productinfo AS
SELECT
  p.ProductID,
  p.ProductName,
  p.Unit,
  p.Price,
  c.CategoryID,
  c.CategoryName,
  c.Description AS CategoryDescription,
  s.SupplierID,
  s.SupplierName,
  s.ContactName AS SupplierContactName,
  s.Address AS SupplierAddress,
  s.City AS SupplierCity,
  s.PostalCode AS SupplierPostalCode,
  s.Country AS SupplierCountry
FROM products AS p
JOIN categories AS c ON c.CategoryID = p.CategoryID
JOIN suppliers AS s ON s.SupplierID = p.SupplierID;
SELECT * FROM productinfo;
